scenes.title_en: Subject Position and the Key Light
scenes.context: 侧向窗户让面部出现阴影、立体感增强；环境暗时加一盏可控主灯实现明暗分离。
sentences: 掌握这套逻辑，就能还原出高级感。
Master this logic, and you can recreate that premium look.
premium look（高级感）
脸朝着光，整个面部的光会比较平。
Facing the light, your whole face looks flat.
flat（平，无立体感）
加一盏灯，人物瞬间从背景里跳了出来。
Add one light, and you instantly pop out from the background.
pop out（跳出来/突出）
paraphrase: 「立体感」换种说法
The face gains depth and sculpted shadows.
「稳定的太阳」的表达
A controllable light that never depends on weather.
scenes.speak: Master this logic, and you can recreate that premium look. Facing the light, your whole face looks flat. Add one light, and you instantly pop out from the background.

scenes.context: 20mm 广角拉伸适合小空间、50mm 人眼视角但空间要求高、35mm 是小空间口播最实用的折中选择。
sentences: 20 毫米，人物离相机大约一臂距离。
At 20 millimeters, the subject is about an arm's length from the camera.
arm's length（一臂距离）
50 毫米观感最接近人眼。
50 millimeters looks the closest to the human eye.
closest to the human eye（最接近人眼）
35 毫米是小空间口播最实用的焦段。
35 millimeters is the most practical focal length for tight talking-head shots.
practical（实用）
paraphrase: 「广角拉伸」的表达
The wide-angle perspective stretches the room.
「虚化分离感」换说法
Background blur separates you from the backdrop.
scenes.speak: At 20 millimeters, the subject is about an arm's length from the camera. 50 millimeters looks the closest to the human eye. 35 millimeters is the most practical focal length for tight talking-head shots.

scenes.context: 图传加 iPad 监看，或 USB-C 连手机免费平替；手机屏幕还能当提示器。
sentences: 翻转屏也很难看清画面。
Even the flip screen is hard to see.
flip screen（翻转屏）
可以试试这个免费的软件。
You can try this free app instead.
free app（免费软件）
眼神不会飘来飘去。
Your eyes won't wander around.
wander（飘忽/游离）
paraphrase: 「监看画面」的表达
Use your phone as a live monitor.
「直视观众」换说法
It feels like you're looking straight at the viewers.
scenes.speak: Even the flip screen is hard to see. You can try this free app instead. Your eyes won't wander around.

scenes.context: 反光板调阴影强度、背景暖光与主光色温差、轮廓光勾勒发丝、成像镜头加树叶做造型光。
sentences: 在人物另一侧放一块反光板。
Put a reflector on the other side of the subject.
reflector（反光板）
背景和主光就有了色温差。
The background and key light now have a color-temperature gap.
color-temperature gap（色温差）
仿佛背景的暖光洒在人物发丝边缘。
As if the warm background light falls on the edge of the hair.
falls on the edge（洒在边缘）
paraphrase: 「轮廓光」的表达
A rim light outlines the subject's shape.
「斑驳光影」换说法
Dappled light and shadow cast across the wall.
scenes.speak: Put a reflector on the other side of the subject. The background and key light now have a color-temperature gap. As if the warm background light falls on the edge of the hair.

scenes.context: 手机 APP 统一控灯，S-Log3 拍摄，套用定制 LUT 直接出片；一盏灯也能拍出层次。
sentences: 通过手机 APP 统一管控所有灯光的亮度和色温。
Use the phone app to control every light's brightness and color temperature.
brightness（亮度）
前机把光线做到位，后期压力非常小。
Nail the light on set, and post-production becomes effortless.
on set（前机/现场）
一盏灯也能拍出有层次的画面。
Even one light can create a layered shot.
layered shot（有层次的画面）
paraphrase: 「直接出片」的表达
You can deliver the video right away.
「对光的理解」换说法
It comes down to understanding light.
scenes.speak: Use the phone app to control every light's brightness and color temperature. Nail the light on set, and post-production becomes effortless. Even one light can create a layered shot.

practice: 脸朝着光会有什么问题？
Facing the light makes the whole face look flat.
小空间口播首选什么焦段？
35mm — it balances framing and room constraints.
手机屏幕除了监看还能做什么？
轮廓光一般设什么色温？
Set it close to the background light (e.g. 3200K) to keep lighting logic consistent.
pitfalls: Side light creates shadows and depth; facing the light keeps the face flat.
Raise the ISO when it's dark.
Higher ISO also brightens the background and kills the separation.
Pick the focal length by room size; 35mm for small spaces.
50mm needs about 1.5m camera distance plus 2-3m of backdrop space.
Use as many lights as possible.
Control light position and color temperature first.
Texture comes from light ratios and color gaps, not lamp count.
shifts: 以前画面暗就调高 ISO
现在加一盏可控灯，背景保持自然亮度
现在侧向光源靠阴影建立立体感
以前觉得质感要靠昂贵设备
现在一盏灯+正确光位就能出层次
